```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
game_id <- 401856883
teams <- collect(tbl(con, "teams"))
```

```{r}
#| label: game-epa
# The game's rated scrimmage plays with each play's EPA (the same model as
# the running-total card), then each rated play's band and quarter.
plays <- game_plays(con, game_id)
home <- plays$home[1]
away <- plays$away[1]
season <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT gameId, driveId, driveNumber, playNumber, period, offense, ",
    "defense, home, away, offenseScore, defenseScore, yardline, yardsToGoal, ",
    "down, distance, yardsGained, playType, playText, ppa ",
    "FROM plays WHERE season = 2026"
  )
)
fit <- game_ep_fit(season)
epa <- game_epa_model(game_scrimmage(plays), fit)
bands <- game_bands(epa, threshold = 1.5)
band_levels <- c(
  "Negative play (EPA below 0)",
  "Ordinary play (EPA 0 to 1.5)",
  "Explosive play (EPA 1.5+)"
)
qtr <- bands |>
  summarise(epa = sum(ppa), plays = n(), .by = c(offense, quarter, band)) |>
  mutate(
    band = factor(band, band_levels),
    band_short = factor(
      sub(" play.*", "", band),
      c("Negative", "Ordinary", "Explosive")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(qtr, aes(quarter, epa, fill = offense)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>",
        offense,
        " ",
        quarter,
        "</b><br>",
        band,
        ": ",
        round(epa, 1),
        " EPA over ",
        plays,
        " plays"
      ),
      data_id = paste(offense, quarter, band)
    ),
    position = "dodge2",
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~band_short) +
  scale_fill_team(teams, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "EPA by quarter, split by play size",
    subtitle = "Each panel is one kind of play; teams sit side by side",
    x = NULL,
    y = "EPA in the quarter",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "game-value-by-quarter", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: explore
# Each band's running EPA within each quarter, one panel per team and quarter.
# Every line starts at 0 when the quarter opens and holds its total to the
# final whistle, so a band with no plays stays flat at 0.
band_steps <- bands |>
  arrange(offense, period, seq) |>
  mutate(band = factor(band, band_levels)) |>
  mutate(cum = cumsum(ppa), .by = c(offense, quarter, band)) |>
  mutate(
    tip = paste0(
      "<b>",
      offense,
      " ",
      quarter,
      ", ",
      clock_minutes,
      ":",
      sprintf("%02d", clock_seconds),
      " left</b><br>",
      playText,
      "<br>",
      band,
      ": ",
      round(ppa, 2),
      " EPA, running ",
      round(cum, 2)
    )
  )
band_ends <- band_steps |>
  summarise(end = last(cum), .by = c(offense, quarter, band)) |>
  tidyr::complete(
    offense = c(home, away),
    quarter = paste0("Q", 1:4),
    band = factor(band_levels, band_levels),
    fill = list(end = 0)
  )
band_lines <- bind_rows(
  transmute(band_ends, offense, quarter, band, minute = 0, cum = 0),
  select(band_steps, offense, quarter, band, minute = minute, cum),
  transmute(band_ends, offense, quarter, band, minute = 15, cum = end)
) |>
  arrange(offense, quarter, band, minute)
p_stack <- ggplot(band_lines, aes(minute, cum, color = band)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = band_steps,
    aes(minute, cum, tooltip = tip),
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  facet_grid(quarter ~ offense) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Negative play (EPA below 0)" = "#b91c1c",
      "Ordinary play (EPA 0 to 1.5)" = "#6b7280",
      "Explosive play (EPA 1.5+)" = "#15803d"
    ),
    name = NULL,
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15)) +
  labs(
    y = "Running EPA within the quarter",
    x = "Minutes into the quarter",
    title = "How each quarter's EPA built up, by play size"
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_stack, width_svg = 11, height_svg = 9)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
bands |>
  count(offense, quarter, band) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = band, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(match(offense, c(home, away)), quarter) |>
  transmute(
    Offense = offense,
    Quarter = quarter,
    Negative = `Negative play (EPA below 0)`,
    Ordinary = `Ordinary play (EPA 0 to 1.5)`,
    Explosive = `Explosive play (EPA 1.5+)`
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Offense", "Quarter", "Negative plays", "Ordinary plays", "Explosive plays"),
    caption = "Scrimmage plays with an EPA in each quarter, by play size."
  )
```
